prompt:
Edit the supplied paint_mask_guide.png as the exact layout and silhouette target. design_reference.png is the approved material/detail reference; icon_x8.png is the original colour reference, magenta background must be ignored.
# Imperial Spear: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10060/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully extrapolate the complete MM9 Imperial Spear in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the slim orange-pale lance point with paired swept barbs, bright green center gem, curved gold quillons, and very long ivory-orange-gold spiral-wrapped lower shaft. Render one full-length spear on genuine transparent RGBA..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: Faithfully extrapolate the complete MM9 Imperial Spear in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the slim orange-pale lance point with paired swept barbs, bright green center gem, curved gold quillons, and very long ivory-orange-gold spiral-wrapped lower shaft. Render one full-length spear on genuine transparent RGBA.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10060/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

CORRECTION: Absolute priority is the original guide alpha silhouettes, not the reference's silhouette. The horizontal LEFT/RIGHT edge-on views are extremely thin rods with tiny thin blade profiles: NEVER show their broad face or gem from the side. Only the vertical TOP cell has the broad barbed blade and curved guard. Keep original silhouette width exactly, including tiny end-on views. Do not add any stray red/yellow pixels or halo around painted silhouettes. Lower rows must use solid clean categorical regions and identical guide alpha. Preserve every position and empty cell. Paint only existing guide pixels; no geometry changes.
validation_notes: Layout retained; visible silhouette drift and stray coloured pixels remain after the one permitted correction. Raw output preserved without editing.
